dimensions.assessment: Affects rural households seeking broadband service and entities applying for rural broadband grants administered by the Department of Agriculture.
dimensions.evidence: award grants under rural broadband programs administered by the Department of Agriculture.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies how the Secretary determines whether a household or service territory is unserved by adding an affordability criterion.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall consider the affordability of broadband service.

dimensions.assessment: Does not appropriate new funds or alter grant funding totals, though it modifies the criteria for awarding existing rural broadband grants.
Amends a single section (Section 601) of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936 to incorporate affordability into unserved definitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 601 of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936 (7 U.S.C. 950bb) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory criteria for USDA rural broadband programs starting one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this Act shall take effect on the date that is 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific metrics or thresholds for what constitutes 'affordability' under the amended Act.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill makes a targeted statutory amendment to require the consideration of broadband service affordability when determining unserved areas in USDA rural broadband grant programs.
